query_text: Create a slope chart comparing each value-chain segment’s share of all companies founded in or after 2020 against its share of all companies with `Mosaic >= 850`, counting each company once and sorting segments by the increase from founder-share to high-Mosaic-share.
sort_rule: descending by increase from recent-founder share to high-Mosaic share
selection_rule: segment shares within the recent-founder subset and the Mosaic>=850 subset

plot_config.title: Segment share shift: recent founders vs high-Mosaic firms
plot_config.left_label: Share of companies founded in or after 2020

reasoning_summary: Assigned segment membership from section-2 boundaries.
Built the recent-founder subset using Founded year >= 2020.
Built the high-Mosaic subset using Mosaic >= 850.
Computed segment shares within each subset and sorted by share increase.
